# Talk with Liam — Psychotherapeutic Counselling

> Relational, Transactional Analysis psychotherapeutic counselling with **Liam Doran** (UKCP Trainee Member) in Willerby, East Yorkshire (`HU10 7UA`) and UK-wide online via Google Meet.

## Core Practice Summary
- **Practitioner**: Liam Doran, UKCP Trainee Psychotherapeutic Counsellor (Ellesmere Centre for Psychotherapy & Counselling, Hull; clinical placement at Valued Minds, Hull; regular UKCP-accredited clinical supervision).
- **Modality**: Relational Transactional Analysis (TA), Humanistic & Person-Centred, Somatic Nervous-System Grounding, Trauma-Informed.
- **Session Fee**: £30 per 50-minute session (in-person and online); free initial introductory video consultation; concession sliding-scale slots for students and low incomes.
- **In-Person Location**: The Willerby Practice, 1b The Square, Willerby, East Yorkshire, HU10 7UA (second floor, stairs access; free nearby parking by Sainsbury's; convenient for Hull, Cottingham, Hessle, Kirk Ella, Anlaby, North Ferriby, Swanland, and Beverley).
- **Online Coverage**: United Kingdom-wide via Google Meet.
- **Contact**: talkwithliamtherapy@gmail.com | +44 7344 145282 | https://wa.me/447344145282

## Key Pages & Psychoeducation Guides
- [Home](https://talkwithliam.co.uk/): Editorial introduction and navigation across all practice chapters and TA theory explorers.
- [About Liam Doran](https://talkwithliam.co.uk/about): Personal background, working-class roots, Ellesmere Centre training, Valued Minds placement, peer reflections, and ethical stance.
- [How We Work](https://talkwithliam.co.uk/how-we-work): Equal Adult-to-Adult relational counselling without pedestals or clinical scripts.
- [Relational Transactional Analysis Approach](https://talkwithliam.co.uk/approach): Collaborating as equals, old survival blueprints, nervous-system pacing, and what to expect in session one.
- [Areas of Work](https://talkwithliam.co.uk/areas-of-work): Anxiety & panic, relationship patterns & attachment, burnout & perfectionism, low mood, and grief or life transitions.
- [Fees (£30) & The Willerby Practice](https://talkwithliam.co.uk/fees): Session rates, concessions, 48-hour cancellation policy, Willerby HU10 7UA commute/parking info, and Google Meet online details.
- [Contact & Free Intro Chat](https://talkwithliam.co.uk/contact): Direct email, WhatsApp, phone, confidentiality notice, and UK crisis support numbers.
- [Practice Guide & FAQs](https://talkwithliam.co.uk/faq): 15 detailed answers covering NHS medical records privacy, GP referrals, first sessions, fees, and accessibility.
- [The PAC Model (Transactional Analysis)](https://talkwithliam.co.uk/pac-model): Interactive psychoeducation guide to Parent, Adult & Child core ego states and Functional states (CP, NP, A, AC, FC) with YouTube explainer.
- [The Drama Triangle & Winner's Triangle](https://talkwithliam.co.uk/drama-triangle): Interactive guide comparing Karpman's Persecutor, Rescuer & Victim roles with Acey Choy's Assertive, Caring & Vulnerable responses across real-life scenarios.
- [The Camera & The Free Child](https://talkwithliam.co.uk/free-child): Essay on Eric Berne's Free Child vs. Adapted Child alongside 35mm East Yorkshire street photography.
